commercial_readback: core.commercial_readback.bind_remote_identity requires the observed object id to match the create response before material fields count.
consumer: core.assignment_executor._action_registry_adapter passes authorized request digest/operation/provider/organization/target separately; a refuted, missing, None or errored verdict downgrades a dispatched mutation to uncertain and retains remote identity.
coverage_scope: Registered action-registry mutation classes only. This is not a whole-application dispatch inventory; ORACLE-01 marketing closure still requires the full dispatch/coverage inventory in the verification plan.
draft_readback: core.connected_actions.outlook_create_draft independently calls get_email_by_id; missing identity/material fields are incomplete, a different object id or material mismatch is conflict, and no second draft is created.
request_binding: core.connected_actions.oracle_request_binding derives the expected provider material digest, provider, operation, organization and target from the authorized arguments using the same canonical payload builders the action uses before dispatch.
